text: simply bata ki tujhe humare pichle conversation ke baare mai kuch yaad hai kya ha ya nahi aur hai toh kya kya yad hai bata
Haan, mujhe memory hai! Let me read what I've saved from previous conversations.

Bilkul! Mujhe kaafi kuch yaad hai. Yeh rahi summary:

## 📝 Saved Memories:

### 1. **Agent Rules** (4 days old)
- Memory check करो हर session के शुरू में
- Risky actions (git push, delete) के लिए confirmation लो
- Memory update करो big changes के baad
- Security first (OWASP)
- Concise communication - short answers, no narration
- Code quality - minimal comments, self-explanatory code

### 2. **User Preferences**
- Hindi/Hinglish mix में communicate करना है
- Short और direct answers चाहिए
- Don't repeat what was done - तुम diff देख सकते हो
- Results-focused communication
- Windows 11 environment पर काम कर रहे हो
- Email: sunil.22210652@viit.ac.in

## 🔍 Project Context (System Memory):
- **MEMO project** - Node.js CLI for Git repo memory
- **Phase P4** reached - all tests passing
- **Recent issues:** 
  - Windows scheduled task registration failed
  - Test failure in `process.test.js` (redact function)
- **Provider:** Groq selected for live testing
- **Recent sessions:** 12 sessions, 53 records

Toh basically, मैं तुम्हारी working style, preferences, और current project status को याद रखता हूँ। अब क्या करना है?
ok toh tu koi default file check karti hai , hamesha ha ya nahi

Nahi, asal mein **nahi consistently** check karta. 

AGENTS.md mein likha hai:
> **Before starting work**
> - Read `.memory/PROJECT_STATE.md` if it exists
> - If it does not exist, read `.memory/progress.md`

Toh **chahiye** to hamesha check karna, lekin practically I didn't do it automatically jab tu session start hua. Sirf tab check kiya jab tune specifically poocha.

## Kya hona chahiye?
Mujhe har session ke start mein automatically:
1. `.memory/PROJECT_STATE.md` check करना चाहिए
2. अगर वो नहीं है तो `.memory/progress.md` check करना चाहिए
3. फिर काम शुरू करना चाहिए

Chahte ho ki mein yeh consistently करूँ? Mein ek automation setup kar sakta hoon ताकि यह automatically हो जाए।
